{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Drop the 6 QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~(sales['revenue'] == '999,999.99')]

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales_clean['revenue'] = sales_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm conversion
print("First 5 converted revenue values:", sales_clean['revenue'].head(5).tolist())
print("Revenue dtype:", sales_clean['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Drop refunded orders for revenue and conversion analysis (since they are not real sales)
sales_final = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']
print("After removing refunded orders, shape:", sales_final.shape)"}
